title: 66:15 the Lord will come with fire/chariots/whirlwind/flames of fire. When the Lord returns he will bring with him a devouring fire, which shall burn the wicked as stubble and cleanse the world with flame (Mal. 4:1; D&C 29:9). Fire and flames of fire also symbolize God's glory and unapproachable holiness (30:27; Ex. 3:2). Chariots and the whirlwind symbolize God's power in bringing justice; the whirlwind also suggests the swiftness with which the Lord comes to destroy the wicked (19:1; Jer. 4:13; Ps. 104:3; Abr. 2:7).
author: Tina M. Peterson
